description: US Treasury auction results: high yield/rate, bid-to-cover ratio, and offering/accepted amounts for recently settled bills, notes, bonds, TIPS, and floating-rate notes (FRNs), with CUSIP, from the Treasury Fiscal Data auctions dataset. A reopening (e.g. a "9-Year 10-Month" auction reopening an original 10-year note) is matched by its ORIGINAL nominal term, so term:"10-Year" finds both new 10-year note auctions and reopenings of one. Only settled auctions (with a published rate) are returned; upcoming announced-but-unsettled auctions are excluded.

limit.description: Number of auctions to return (default 10, max 50)

security_type.description: Security category: "Bill", "Note", "Bond", "TIPS", or "FRN" (floating-rate note). Omit for the most recent settled auctions across all types.

term.description: Original nominal term, e.g. "4-Week", "13-Week", "26-Week", "52-Week" (bills); "2-Year", "3-Year", "5-Year", "7-Year", "10-Year" (notes); "20-Year", "30-Year" (bonds/TIPS). Matched against the security's ORIGINAL term, so it still finds reopenings labeled with a shorter remaining term. Omit for all terms.

name: treasury_auction_results
title: Treasury Auction Results
